name: Damage Wrestling Federation World Championship
epitaph: Billed champion Tom E. Gunn lost the title to General Glove in a two-out-of-three-falls match on Damage's own Saturday Night Fever of 4 August 1997, the only change recorded in this record.

name: Damage Wrestling Federation Blood Bash Title
epitaph: Created as a prize for the Blood Bash '97 rumble but never awarded: winner General Glove chose to challenge for the World Championship instead.
